limitations: Classifies singular moduli and nullity, not every complex Fourier eigenvalue phase.
The unnormalized operator is never invertible for positive slice dimension.
Asymptotics fix field size and let dimension increase; no joint growth regime is asserted.
Universal proof uses known quadratic-form counts and Euler identities; the checker only covers finite examples.
A broader unlocated specialized formula may have historical priority.

scientific_integrity.priority_caveat: Searches do not prove novelty, and related general quadratic-form sources exist.
scientific_integrity.same_model_review: Correctness, originality, and mathematical value assessed with bounded literature comparisons and a self-contained finite checker.
